description: This is a development time only object type. Objects of this type in generate/objects are processed to produce one polymorphic _AdaptiveFunction_ plus one for each dataType in polymorphicDataTypes.

dataTypeMethod.description: If true, this is a data type method that can be called polymorphically or by prefixing the function with the data type followed by double colons ('::').
dataTypeMethod.label: Data Type Method

dataTypeRequired.description: If true, no function is registered for functionId itself. Each data type specific function is a plain function whose functionId is functionId_dataType, such as is_string, and functionId<dataType>, such as is<string>, is another way to call it. Use this when the data type is what the function is about (is, as), not the data type of its first parameter.
dataTypeRequired.label: Data Type Required

errorsThrown.description: Errors a script author may want to catch for this function (id plus a short reason). Not every possible failure. Do not list general. The error value must be a name from the error code map.
errorsThrown.label: Errors Thrown

polymorphicExecuteFunctionEvaluatesFirst.brief: First parameter evaluate deferred to polymorphicExecuteFunction
polymorphicExecuteFunctionEvaluatesFirst.description: If true, the first parameter evaluate is deferred to polymorphicExecuteFunction function. If false or not specified, standard polymorphic function processing evaluates the first parameter to determine the appropriate evaluate to call.
polymorphicExecuteFunctionEvaluatesFirst.label: Defer Evaluate
